event.note: A real M4.06 earthquake occurred inside the radar frame between the two acquisitions. The recorded attribution run classified coseismic deformation as insufficient-evidence: the 48 mm-scale apparent changes cannot be distinguished from the 72 mm ionospheric contamination, and no deformation claim was made.

narrative.verdict: No motion detectable. Ionosphere-related noise (72 mm) exceeds the largest apparent signal (48 mm).
narrative.whatChanged: Between 22 May and 3 June 2026, the largest apparent movement toward or away from the satellite across the measurable part of this scene was about 48 mm — below what this data can confidently resolve, because the radar signal passed through a severely disturbed ionosphere. The un-applied ionospheric correction leaves a systematic contamination floor of about 72 mm. No area passed the detection threshold.
narrative.howMuch: 0 km² of the ~2,074 km² measurable area was flagged. Only ~1.7% of the frame could be measured at all (signal quality collapsed under the ionospheric disturbance); 99.7% of the valid region shows no apparent change.
narrative.reliability: The honest summary is that this pair cannot support any deformation claim: the ionospheric systematic floor (72 mm) is larger than the largest apparent signal (48 mm). A real M4.06 earthquake (Johannesburg, CA, 1 June 2026, 7.6 km depth) occurred inside the frame between acquisitions — the evidence is insufficient to attribute any of the small apparent changes to it.

attributionSummary.methodNote: Recorded from the 2026-10-20 attribution run: event ranking selected ci41478192 as primary (only in-window event near the footprint); the forward-model check was skipped because the published record carried no fault-plane mechanism, and no fault geometry was invented to fill the gap.

warnings: Recorded result: the source granule (2.58 GB) is no longer stored on this server, so this analysis cannot currently be re-executed. Every number here was captured from the recorded run of the real product.
86% of pixels that passed the signal-quality check were excluded because they sit outside the single valid unwrapping region (filler phase over un-unwrapable areas).
The ionospheric phase screen is supplied in the product but NOT applied to the stored phase (ASF NISAR GUNW guide); its uncertainty (median 3.73 rad ≈ 72 mm) sets the systematic floor here.
